record.context_brief: Locally Stein open subsets of Stein spaces
record.original_question: Let M be a compact complex manifold. Find some appropriate conditions on M such that if U is an open subset of M which is locally Stein, then U is Stein.

evidence.quote: Problem 4.1.2 Let M be a compact complex manifold. Find some appropriate conditions on M such that if U is an open subset of M which is locally Stein, then U is Stein. -N. Sibony, sibony@anh.matups.fr 4.2 The Runge Problem

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A complex manifold $X$ is called Stein if it is holomorphically convex, holomorphically separable, and admits global holomorphic coordinates near every point (equivalently, it admits a strictly plurisubharmonic exhaustion function). An open subset $U$ of a complex manifold $M$ is called locally Stein (or locally pseudoconvex) in $M$ if every point $p \in \partial U \cap M$ has an open neighborhood $V$ in $M$ such that $U \cap V$ is a Stein open subset of $V$.

Let $M$ be a compact complex manifold. Determine natural geometric, cohomological, or curvature-type conditions on $M$ which guarantee the following implication: for every open subset $U \subset M$ that is locally Stein in $M$, $U$ is itself a Stein manifold.
artifact.status_search_result: The question, attributed to Sibony, asks for conditions on a compact complex manifold $M$ ensuring that locally Stein open subsets are Stein. Classical results (Docquier–Grauert) handle the case where the ambient space is Stein, and Grauert's examples show pseudoconvexity alone is not sufficient. More recent work (e.g., Mongodi–Slodkowski–Tomassini on Levi currents, and various works on the Levi problem in compact Kähler/projective manifolds) gives partial criteria but no fully general answer; the problem appears still open.

status_evidence.title: On Minimal Kernels and Levi Currents
status_evidence.snippet: Levi currents are introduced to study obstructions to Steinness of pseudoconvex open subsets in complex manifolds, addressing the Levi problem posed by Sibony.
status_evidence.claim: The Levi/Steinness problem in compact complex manifolds is actively studied with only partial criteria, indicating the problem remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Levi problem in complex manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the Levi problem in (compact) complex manifolds, providing partial results on when locally pseudoconvex/Stein domains are Stein.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress exists but the general criterion sought by Sibony has not been established.
